import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 10;
    static final int MAXV = 203;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;

    static char[][] mp = new char[N][N];
    static int[][] n_experts = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] n_help = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] infected_at = new int[N][N];
    static int[][][][] tim = new int[N][N][N][N];

    static int[] dir_i = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dir_j = {0, 0, -1, 1};

    static class Edge {
        int to, rev, cap;
        Edge(int to, int rev, int cap) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static ArrayList<Edge>[] flow_graph = new ArrayList[MAXV];

    static void add_flow_edge(int u, int v, int c) {
        flow_graph[u].add(new Edge(v, flow_graph[v].size(), c));
        flow_graph[v].add(new Edge(u, flow_graph[u].size() - 1, 0));
    }

    static int edmonds_karp(int s, int t) {
        int total = 0;
        while (true) {
            int[] parent = new int[MAXV];
            int[] parent_edge = new int[MAXV];
            Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
            parent[s] = s;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty() && parent[t] == -1) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (int i = 0; i < flow_graph[u].size(); ++i) {
                    Edge e = flow_graph[u].get(i);
                    if (e.cap > 0 && parent[e.to] == -1) {
                        parent[e.to] = u;
                        parent_edge[e.to] = i;
                        q.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (parent[t] == -1) break;
            int push = INF;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]) {
                push = Math.min(push, flow_graph[parent[v]].get(parent_edge[v]).cap);
            }
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]) {
                Edge e = flow_graph[parent[v]].get(parent_edge[v]);
                e.cap -= push;
                flow_graph[v].get(e.rev).cap += push;
            }
            total += push;
        }
        return total;
    }

    static int node_no(int n, int i, int j, boolean right) {
        return i * n + j + (right ? n * n : 0);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        int blast_i = -1, blast_j = -1;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (ch == 'Y') {
                    mp[i][j] = 'Y';
                } else if (ch == 'Z') {
                    mp[i][j] = 'Z';
                    blast_i = i;
                    blast_j = j;
                } else {
                    mp[i][j] = '.';
                    n_experts[i][j] += ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (ch != 'Y' && ch != 'Z') {
                    n_help[i][j] += ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        // Initialize infected_at with -1
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(infected_at[i], -1);
        }
        infected_at[blast_i][blast_j] = 0;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{blast_i, blast_j});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int i = cur[0], j = cur[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int ni = i + dir_i[d], nj = j + dir_j[d];
                if (0 <= ni && ni < n && 0 <= nj && nj < n && mp[ni][nj] == '.' && infected_at[ni][nj] == -1) {
                    infected_at[ni][nj] = infected_at[i][j] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{ni, nj});
                }
            }
        }

        // Initialize tim with -1
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                for (int ii = 0; ii < n; ++ii) {
                    Arrays.fill(tim[i][j][ii], -1);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (mp[i][j] != '.') continue;
                tim[i][j][i][j] = 0;
                Queue<int[]> qq = new LinkedList<>();
                qq.add(new int[]{i, j});
                while (!qq.isEmpty()) {
                    int[] cur = qq.poll();
                    int ii = cur[0], jj = cur[1];
                    if (infected_at[ii][jj] == -1 || tim[i][j][ii][jj] < infected_at[ii][jj]) {
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                            int ni = ii + dir_i[d], nj = jj + dir_j[d];
                            if (0 <= ni && ni < n && 0 <= nj && nj < n && mp[ni][nj] == '.'
                                && (infected_at[ni][nj] == -1 || tim[i][j][ii][jj] + 1 <= infected_at[ni][nj])
                                && tim[i][j][ni][nj] == -1) {
                                tim[i][j][ni][nj] = tim[i][j][ii][jj] + 1;
                                qq.add(new int[]{ni, nj});
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int src = 2 * n * n;
        int sink = src + 1;

        // Initialize flow graph
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXV; ++i) {
            flow_graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (n_experts[i][j] > 0) {
                    add_flow_edge(src, node_no(n, i, j, false), n_experts[i][j]);
                }
                if (n_help[i][j] > 0) {
                    add_flow_edge(node_no(n, i, j, true), sink, n_help[i][j]);
                }
                for (int ii = 0; ii < n; ++ii) {
                    for (int jj = 0; jj < n; ++jj) {
                        if (0 <= tim[i][j][ii][jj] && tim[i][j][ii][jj] <= t) {
                            add_flow_edge(node_no(n, i, j, false), node_no(n, ii, jj, true), INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(edmonds_karp(src, sink));
        sc.close();
    }
}
